messages:
sam: Heads-up 1 I opened a docs PR to update the Marlin13B model card: long-context bench results (32k vs 64k), tokenizer note for byte-pair splits, and an SDK v4 snippet for streaming embeddings with shard hints. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4897 :sparkles:

nora: nice. can you call out which hardware was used for the 64k runs? previous table didn't state GPU model and that confused a couple of customers. :thinking:

sam: yep -- added a footnote: 64k runs were on A100-80GB, fp16, batch_size=1, pinned-seqlen mode. 32k runs used A100-40GB, batch_size=2. will include raw bench script in the repo.

devon: small but important  the tokenizer change in runtime v2.3 increases token count for some code-heavy prompts. suggest adding a "tokenization caveat" section with before/after examples and a link to the runtime changelog.

sam: good call. I'll add a short example: 

"Example: 'def main():'
 - runtime v2.2 tokenized to 3 tokens
 - runtime v2.3 tokenized to 5 tokens (BPE split update)"

sam: also adding a migration blurb for customers using long-context checkpoints (how to adjust cache size and batch windows).

eva-qa: please add these to the eval checklist: reproduce 32k and 64k with the bench script, run decode-quality sweep on the code prompts, and run mem-leak smoke test with repeated open/close contexts. I'll queue tests after the PR lands. ETA ~6 hours.

devon: SDK snippet request: we should show JS streaming embeddings with shard hint and graceful fallback to append-only batching. proposed snippet:

```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const stream = client.embeddings.stream({
  model: 'marlin13b',
  input: 'function compute(a, b) { return a + b }',
  shard_hint: 'code-heavy',
  fallback: { mode: 'append-batch', maxBatchMs: 50 }
})
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  console.log(chunk.embedding.slice(0, 8))
}
```

nora: tiny nit  change shard_hint to "code:high" to match the shard taxonomy in the embedding docs. Also ensure we hyperlink to the embedding-shards docs page.

infra-bot: CI build triggered for docs PR #4897, status: pending (https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9234).

sam: done on the hint rename and added link to https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings/sharding. updated bench table to include GPU column and bench script link. assigning reviewers @nora @eva-qa @devon. target merge before catalog cut next Wednesday. :calendar:

eva-qa: I'll post test results here when complete. if any alignment regressions show up we'll hold the merge and file an incident.

nora: I'll skim the JS snippet and the tokenization examples tomorrow morning. :coffee:
